name: Henry M. Teller
bio: Henry M. Teller, Secretary of the Interior, appeared in the Cow Boy in March 1884 as the official cattlemen petitioned to keep open a cattle trail from Texas, and in January 1885 as the secretary a congressional committee asked for details of land leases. In June 1885 the paper printed a reply from a "Sec'y. Teller" on taxes levied on Billings County by Morton and Stark counties.
